preconditions.description: The number of intersections n is a positive integer between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= i <= n for i in range(1, n + 1)) and all(i <= a[i - 1] <= n for i in range(1, n + 1)) and all(a[i - 1] <= a[i] for i in range(1, n))
preconditions.description: The input array a has length n, where each a[i] (1-based) satisfies i ≤ a[i] ≤ n, and the sequence a is non-decreasing.

postconditions.description: The output is a space-separated string of n integers, where the i-th integer (1-based) is the minimum energy required to reach intersection i from intersection 1, computed as the minimum total energy over all possible paths from 1 to i.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= min_energies[i - 1] <= n for i in range(1, n + 1))
postconditions.description: Each minimum energy value is a non-negative integer bounded by n.
